audience: social media teams that plan and approve posts for their pages in Planable

useCases.title: Review the scheduled posts of a page
useCases.text: List the workspaces to get the workspace id. Then list the posts filtered by page and scheduled date, and open one post.

useCases.title: Check the metrics of a page
useCases.text: List the connected pages, then read the follower and engagement metrics of one page over a date range.

useCases.title: Draft a post and send it to approvers
useCases.text: Create a post draft that follows the approval settings. Then request approval from the approvers. The tools do not publish or approve the post.

useCases.title: Upload media and create a label
useCases.text: Upload public image or video URLs to the media library. Then create a coloured label to tag the posts.

useCases.title: Discuss a draft with the team
useCases.text: List the internal comments on a post. Then add a reply. Clients see it only when the post is not team-only.
